subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Do you approve advancing the per-agent SQLite schema from v11 to v12 for session-owned ACP parent-stream diagnostics in this release?
rationale: Repository policy reserves SQLite schema-version advances for explicit acceptance because already-deployed per-agent databases will migrate on upgrade; code review cannot safely supply that release decision.

options.title: Approve v12 migration
options.body: Accept the session-owned ACP diagnostics table and schema-version advance after reviewing the upgrade proof.

options.title: Keep diagnostics out of the agent schema
options.body: Require a design revision that avoids the per-agent schema bump if this persistent storage change is not approved for the release.

recommendation.title: Approve v12 migration
recommendation.body: Accept the session-owned ACP diagnostics table and schema-version advance after reviewing the upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged session/transcript SQLite refactor is the closest available ownership signal for the adjacent per-agent database boundary.
